leadIn.title: Lead-In & Context: Like / Love / Hate + -ing
leadIn.content: Expressing preferences and hobbies: Anna loves swimming, likes reading books, but hates waiting in line.

form.title: Form & Structure: Like / Love / Hate + -ing
form.content: Subject + love / like / enjoy / don't mind / hate + verb-ing (e.g. I like cooking).

pronunciation.title: Pronunciation Notes: Like / Love / Hate + -ing

controlledPractice.question: 'I like ___ football.'
controlledPractice.explanation: After like/love/hate, the next verb takes the -ing form.

controlledPractice.question: Fix: 'She loves to dance and to sing.'
controlledPractice.explanation: Both verbs after 'loves' should take -ing: dancing and singing.

controlledPractice.question: Which shows the strongest liking?
controlledPractice.explanation: Love is the strongest of the four on the preference scale.
